task.title: Implement special handling for: 1) Dead letter queue for exhausted retries, 2) Watchdog/killer for stuck tasks (auto-kill after timeout), 3) Failure categorization (network, timeout, logic, etc.), 4) Alerts for repeated failures, 5) Auto-pause/resume for long tasks. Use PostgreSQL to track and analyze abnormal events.
